---
title: "No Graphviz, No Script"
# bd-ijlapt70: the runtime is written out and linked only when a dot
# block exists. A doc with only ordinary code blocks must not reference
# it, and the ordinary block must keep its normal rendering.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - []
        - ["pre.graphviz"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ["viz-global\\.js", "Viz\\.instance"]
---
